description: An explanation of benefits from a fictional self-funded employer plan with two in-network claims: an office visit (the seed decides whether it has lab work) and an adult preventive visit. It is a clean control with no planted errors or decoys; the seed picks the plan option (PPO or HSA-qualified), coverage tier and insurer.

sources.what: Content of a notice of adverse benefit determination (every EOB that pays less than billed)
